mapper.sql: a.id, a.application_no, a.employee_id, a.type, a.sub_type, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.duration_hours, a.reason, a.attachment_file_id, a.status, a.current_approver_id, a.submitted_at, a.finished_at, a.created_at
LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = a.employee_id

(SELECT u.nickname FROM biz_application_approval ap2 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ap2.approver_id WHERE ap2.application_id = a.id ORDER BY ap2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS approverName, (SELECT ap2.action FROM biz_application_approval ap2 WHERE ap2.application_id = a.id ORDER BY ap2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastAction, (SELECT ap2.comment FROM biz_application_approval ap2 WHERE ap2.application_id = a.id ORDER BY ap2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastComment
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_application (application_no, employee_id, type, sub_type, start_time, end_time, duration_hours, reason, attachment_file_id, status, current_approver_id, submitted_at) VALUES (#{applicationNo}, #{employeeId}, #{type}, #{subType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationHours}, #{reason}, #{attachmentFileId}, #{status}, #{currentApproverId}, #{submittedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_application SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_application_approval (application_id, approver_id, action, comment) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{approverId}, #{action}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, approver_id, action, comment, created_at FROM biz_application_approval WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT , e.name AS employeeName, NULL AS approverName, NULL AS lastAction, NULL AS lastComment FROM biz_application a
WHERE a.status = 'APPROVED' AND a.start_time <= #{end} AND a.end_time >= #{start} ORDER BY a.employee_id, a.start_time
